report.explanation: Operator hypothesis of a faulty deployment causing checkout errors is contradicted by current telemetry: all sampled checkout traces return 200 with ok results, order metrics show 21.3 req/60s on /v1/orders all status 200 and zero 502s, and the only deployment record is baseline 1.0.0 with no previous version. No current evidence establishes checkout errors or a deployment regression, so this is handed off rather than asserting a bounded cause.
missing_evidence: Logs for order/checkout (ev-...-order-logs excluded) to confirm whether any checkout errors actually occurred and their error class.
Error-rate metrics for /v1/checkout and gateway routes; current order metrics show only 200s and zero 502s.
Deployment history beyond baseline-order-v1 (1.0.0, no previous version); no evidence of a faulty rollout.
Evidence of version 2.0.0 traffic or rollout status; metrics show 2.0.0 with zero requests.
Trace spans with non-ok request.result or non-200 status to substantiate checkout errors.
